articles.summary: Video games are the most dynamic form of entertainment today. Adeia is a pioneer in interactive media, and has been actively inventing new ways to improve game-playing interaction.
articles.title: Adeia Paves a Technological Path for Making Games More Enjoyable

articles.summary: Gen AI is already being used to create commentary – and commentators – for all kinds of video, leveraging sophisticated architectures like generative adversarial networks (GAN), latent diffusion models, and hybrid approaches that combine multiple synthesis methodologies. The types of video include explainers, how-to’s, unboxings, and more. This commentary, originally audio-only, is increasingly delivered by AI-generated graphical characters. Examples of this could be found in abundance at CES 2026.
articles.title: Skipping the Trip to the Uncanny Valley with Generative AI

articles.summary: The modern car is rapidly evolving beyond transport into a connected, software-driven experience. Advances in electrification, infotainment, and personalisation are reshaping how drivers interact with vehicles. As OEMs explore new ways to add value, companies like Adeia are tackling complex data and interface challenges to create safer, smarter, and more intuitive automotive experiences.
articles.title: Innovation in Motion: Adeia and the Future of Connected Vehicles
